VERDICT: KEEP
WHY: The "map-precedes-territory" invariant — precomputing and publishing an immutable plan/RIB before execution so multi-agent behavior becomes auditable plan-vs-world deltas — is a crisp, falsifiable principle with a built-in test, not mere hype. It generalizes beyond flocking to any agent orchestration where determinism and replayability matter, though the concrete compiler is only one instantiation, so it's worth percolating rather than tasking yet.
